text:
alex wang: fyi hit a weird console leak during org switch.

alex wang: steps to repro: 1) open org A dashboard 2) click quick-switch to org B 3) hit back within 200ms 4) see rows from org B rendered for org A

maria gonzalez: ugh. any logs?

alex wang: saw X-Org header missing on /api/console/prefetch call, backend returned last-cached snapshot for previous org.

chen li: can you paste the request/response headers + route? maybe prefetch cache key uses user-id only

alex wang: request snippet:
```
GET /api/console/prefetch?view=dashboard
Headers: { Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, X-Org: "org-A" }
```

alex wang: but sometimes X-Org is "" when switching quickly. suspect race in client router that updates workspace context after prefetch kicks off.

jordan: could be the quick-switch UX triggers two things: setWorkspace -> navigate -> prefetch. if prefetch runs before setWorkspace finishes client ctx is stale.

maria gonzalez: server-side guard would be safer: require org-id in query param or reject if header mismatches session workspace. Add an assertion in router middleware.

chen li: agree. also check console-cache key. right now key = `${userId}:prefetch:${view}`. needs orgId suffix.

alex wang: good catch. i can do a small patch to include orgId in key and add middleware assert. i'll canary on prod for beta orgs.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex wang (PR #3129)

alex wang: PR up: fixes cache key + middleware assert. added unit test for racey header.

maria gonzalez: nice. can we add a quick telemetry event when a header-mismatch happens? want to monitor incidents before rollout.

chen li: add metric: console.prefetch.header_mismatch with tags {fromOrg, toOrg, session_sample}. avoid userId in tags to not leak PII.

alex wang: added metric, emits counts and sample anonymized session id. pushing canary to 10%.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded in canary (10%): sha abc123

jordan: watching logs. so far no header_mismatch events for beta orgs.

maria gonzalez: schedule follow-up in 24h to verify. create ticket for backport to on-prem build.

alex wang: created ticket #CON-487. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

chen li: closing thread when canary fully green.
